Experimental_Design.Conditions: Two tasks in one experiment, administered on two different days. Task1 (Session 2 = Day 2, SMT_1, Task = shape-matching): 8 geometric shapes x matching/nonmatching, no identity dimension. Task2 (Session 3 = Day 3, SMT_2, historical code name ALT2, Task = self-matching): reference (self vs friend) x domain (morality vs ability) x valence (positive vs negative) x Matching (matching vs nonmatching) = 16 conditions; 8 shapes are bound to 12 Chinese labels (4 self labels + 4 other labels realised as he/she pronouns depending on the friend's gender).

Block_Structure.Block_number: 16 per task (Task1: 2 sub-versions [ALT1_1, ALT1_2] x 8 blocks; Task2: 2 sub-tasks [ability, moral] x 8 blocks)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 768 formal trials per task per subject (48 trials per block x 16 blocks); 1536 for subjects who completed both sessions (Session 2 + Session 3). Total rows in this dataset: 1,040,880 (Session 2: 516,864; Session 3: 524,016) for 589 subjects.
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 48 per practice block, repeated adaptively until accuracy >= 60% (observed 96-480 practice trials per task per subject)

Trial_Structure.Fixation_duration: 500 ms (fixation cross onset 500 ms after trial onset; offset 1200 ms)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: 200 ms (shape and label presented simultaneously, 1000-1200 ms after trial onset)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 1200 ms response window (responses accepted from 1000 ms; total trial duration 2200 ms)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms blank from trial onset to fixation onset (no separate ITI node)
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (per-trial feedback: correct / incorrect / too fast / too slow)

Stimulus_Properties.Fixation: white cross (40 px line length, 5 px line width)
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: 8 geometric shapes as PNG images: triangle, square, diamond, trapezoid, circle, pentagon, ellipse, hexagon (190 px wide, approx. 3.8 deg x 3.8 deg); the Shape column stores the shape key (e.g. hexagon) while the raw file keeps the original file path (img/hexagon.png)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Chinese words in 80 px Microsoft YaHei (approx. 3.6 deg x 1.6 deg). Task1: shape names (三角/方形/菱形/梯形/圆形/五边/六边/椭圆; recovered from SMT_1.js words1, the raw file stores English shape keys). Task2: 12 self/friend labels (好我/坏我/强我/弱我 + 好他/坏他/强他/弱他 or 好她/坏她/强她/弱她 depending on the nominated friend's gender)

exp1.detail: Caliber (updated 2026-10-01): the dataset retains the INTERSECTION of the two tasks, i.e. only subjects who completed both Session 2 (Task1 = SMT_1, Day 2) and Session 3 (Task2 = SMT_2, Day 3). 589 subjects / 1,040,880 rows (Session 2: 516,864 rows; Session 3: 524,016 rows); Sample_Size = 589, Valid_Subj = 503 (the authors' final analysis sample), Drop_Subj = 86. This intersection rule is a study-specific decision for this dataset (it is not a project-wide SKILL rule); it is documented in 04_code_and_reproducibility/removed_subjects_log.md section 8 and in the ingestion plan. Excluded by this rule and itemised in removed_subjects_590_to_503.csv: 92 subjects who have Session 2 data only (they did not return for Day 3; 86,352 rows) and 1 record with Session 3 data only (the blank-ID duplicate record, 864 rows, temporarily labelled phase_015_subj_ghost01). Data source: Task1 comes from the authors' released task-level file 01_raw/SMT_1_raw.csv (681 subject IDs, 604,176 rows); Task2 comes from the platform jsPsych export 01_raw/questionnaires_day3_raw.zip -> day2_data.csv filtered to task_id in {prac_ALT2_moral, ALT2, prac_ALT2_ability} (590 records, 524,880 rows). The authors' quality-control exclusions were not applied (minimal preprocessing): the 12 subjects whose Task2 accuracy fell below the published criteria (single condition < 20% or single domain < 60%) and the 69 subjects excluded by the authors for SRET-based reasons (a different task) are retained; all 86 authors-removed subjects other than the blank-ID record have both sessions and therefore remain in the intersection. Users may exclude them for their own analyses. The paper's participant flow (603 attempted / 588 valid / 503 final, Table 6) is recorded in the master index Note. Task1 two-source differences (recorded in removed_subjects_log.md section 7): the authors' file and the platform export are not mutually inclusive (681 vs 644 IDs; 604,176 vs 572,928 rows). phase_003_subj_14 has two runs in the authors' file but only one (the re-run, formal_ALT1_1 accuracy 0.893) in the platform export; phase_017_subj_20 has two complete runs in both sources (two separate session records, elapsed-time reset). Both subjects have no Session 3 data and are therefore excluded by the intersection rule, so no Run column is needed in the retained data (the column was dropped accordingly). phase_003_subj_2 has two runs in the platform export but one in the authors' file; it is inside the intersection and only the authors' single run is kept. A platform-only record with the literal ID 'NA' (ParticipantID 460) is not included because it is absent from the authors' released file. 38 Task1 IDs (phases 002 and 009) are present only in the authors' file; the platform export does not cover those waves. Column derivation: in the platform export the person, domain and valence columns are empty for the task trials, so Shape_Origin/English/Standardized_Identity, Label_English/Standardized_Identity, extraIV1 (domain) and extraIV2 (valence) were derived from the Chinese condition and word strings using the same rule as the authors' quality-control script (590_to_503_subject_qc.py): first character 好/坏 = morality, 强/弱 = ability; 好/强 = positive, 坏/弱 = negative; pronoun 我 = self, 他/她 = friend. Matching is taken from the designed identity column (match/nonmatch). Task1 has no identity dimension, so all Shape/Label identity columns are NonPerson and extraIV1/extraIV2 are NA. CorrResponse is taken directly from the Task2 raw (correct_response) and derived for Task1 from the counterbalanced response-key mapping: each subject used a fixed match/nonmatch -> f/j assignment (307 subjects match = f, 282 subjects match = j), determined from the raw's own correct trials. The derivation is internally consistent over all 516,864 Task1 trials (zero contradictions, including the 4,463 no-response trials) and reproduces the correct_response column of the platform Day-2 export for all 496,848 of its Task1 trials with zero mismatches, so CorrResponse is complete (f or j) for every row. The derivation is implemented in 1_Data/Sun_2026_DataExp/Sun_2026_DataExp_clean.R. ACC uses the project-wide coding (1 correct, 0 incorrect, NA no response); RT_ms/RT_sec are NA when no response was recorded. Practice trials are retained and flagged by the Phase column. Structure: values were filled from the archived programs 04_code_and_reproducibility/procedure/day2/SMT_1.js and day3/SMT_2.js plus initJspsy.js / initJspsy2.js (48 trials per block, 24-trial sample repeated twice; 8 blocks per sub-task, blockTotalNum_same = 7; practice repeated until 60% accuracy, acc = 60; fixation cross 500-1200 ms; shape and label 1000-1200 ms; responses accepted from 1000 ms; trial duration 2200 ms; 500 ms feedback; page background rgb(128,128,128)). The task ran online on the Naodao platform (jsPsych 7.3.1 with the psychophysics plugin), hence Setting = Online and City = NA in the master index. File organisation: the Clean and raw files each exceeded 50 MB and were split at whole-subject boundaries into four parts each (Sun_2026_DataExp_Exp1_Clean_part1-4.csv, Sun_2026_DataExp_Exp1_raw_part1-4.csv) following the large-file split rule; the parts share this JSON file, the single subj_info file and the single codebook, and rbind(part1..part4) restores the original files byte for byte. The raw file keeps the source columns and adds Subject/Session/Task; its Task1 portion retains the authors' original English shape keys and its Task2 portion keeps the original platform values (including img/*.png image paths).
